reviews.name: Kavitha & Sai Kiran
reviews.comment: Cherry Captures made our wedding day unforgettable! TheJeelakarra Bellam and Talambralu shots look like a royal cinema. Every family member was in tears of joy watching our teaser film.

reviews.name: Harish Varma & Deepthi
reviews.comment: The drone shots during sunset were magical. We got our Save the Date video in 48 hours and it trended on Instagram reels with over 50k views! Thank you Cherry garu!

reviews.name: Ananya’s Parents (Venkat & Radhika)
reviews.comment: The traditional Kanchipuram silk colors, the mandap lighting, and our daughter’s candid laughter were preserved with utmost love. Cherry is truly a master with the lens.
